  SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
  FROM inventories i
  WHERE i.set_num = '9472-1'
  ORDER BY i.version DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded AS (
  -- Base: start with the set's own inventory parts
  SELECT 
    ip.part_num,
    ip.color_id,
    ip.quantity AS qty,
    1 AS level
  FROM inventory_parts ip
  WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    AND ip.is_spare = false
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Nested sets: multiply quantities
  SELECT 
    ip.part_num,
    ip.color_id,
    (e.qty * iset.quantity * ip.quantity) AS qty,
    e.level + 1
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
  JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = iset.set_num
  JOIN (
    SELECT inventory_id, set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
    FROM inventories

  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id

  JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
  JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id

  ORDER BY i.version DESC

  -- Direct parts

    ip.part_num,
    ip.color_id,
    ip.quantity AS qty,
    'part' AS item_type
  FROM inventory_parts ip
  WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    AND ip.is_spare = false

  -- Nested sets
  SELECT 
    iset.set_num,
    NULL,
    iset.quantity,
    'set'

  UNION ALL
  
  -- Minifigs
  SELECT 
    im.fig_num,
    NULL,
    im.quantity,
    'minifig'
  FROM inventory_minifigs im
  WHERE im.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
),
-- Recursive CTE to expand nested items
exploded(item_num, color_id, qty, item_type) AS (
  SELECT part_num, color_id, qty, item_type FROM base_items

)

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Find current inventory for BAM2020-1
set_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = 'BAM2020-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive expansion: start with the set's inventory, then expand nested sets and minifigs
-- Each row: (item_type, item_id, quantity_from_parent, inventory_id)
-- item_type: 'set', 'minifig', or 'part'
-- We track the multiplier from parent quantities
expanded AS (
    -- Base: the set's direct inventory
    SELECT 
        'set' AS item_type,
        'BAM2020-1' AS item_id,
        1 AS qty,
        si.inventory_id
    FROM set_inventory si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets in current inventory
    SELECT 
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS item_id,
        e.qty * iset.quantity AS qty,
        (SELECT i2.id FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = iset.set_num ORDER BY i2.version DESC LIMIT 1) AS inventory_id
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')  -- sets can contain nested sets and minifigs; minifigs can contain... no, minifigs don't contain sets
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs in current inventory
    SELECT 
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id,
        e.qty * im.quantity AS qty,
        (SELECT i2.id FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = im.fig_num ORDER BY i2.version DESC LIMIT 1) AS inventory_id
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'  -- only sets contain minifigs
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts in current inventory (terminal, no further expansion)
    SELECT 
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num AS item_id,
        e.qty * ip.quantity AS qty,
        NULL AS inventory_id
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND ip.is_spare = false
),
-- Get all part rows with their accumulated quantities
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        item_id AS part_num,
        qty AS total_qty
    FROM expanded
    WHERE item_type = 'part'
)
SELECT SUM(ap.total_qty) AS total_units
FROM all_parts ap
JOIN colors c ON c.id = (
    SELECT ip2.color_id 
    FROM inventory_parts ip2 
    WHERE ip2.part_num = ap.part_num 
    LIMIT 1
)
WHERE ap.part_num = '41879a'
  AND c.name = 'Green'
"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get the current inventory (highest version) for set 45802-1
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '45802-1'
    ORDER BY version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all parts at any level through nested sets and minifigs
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from nested sets (recursively)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity * iset.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = iset.set_num
    -- Get current inventory of the nested set
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) cur_inv ON cur_inv.set_num = inv.set_num AND inv.version = cur_inv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = inv.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifigs (recursively)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity * im.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = im.fig_num
    -- Get current inventory of the minifig
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) cur_inv ON cur_inv.set_num = inv.set_num AND inv.version = cur_inv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = inv.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT part_num) AS distinct_part_numbers
FROM exploded_parts
"}

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Find the current inventory for the target set
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '75550-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive expansion of contents
-- We track: inventory_id, the item type, the item identifier, and the multiplier quantity
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with the set's current inventory, multiplier = 1
    SELECT 
        ci.id AS root_inventory_id,
        'set' AS item_type,
        ci.set_num AS item_id,
        1 AS multiplier
    FROM current_inventory ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets: each nested set brings its own current inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_inventory_id,
        'set' AS item_type,
        inv.set_num AS item_id,
        e.multiplier * iset.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_num ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand minifigs: each minifig brings its own inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_inventory_id,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id,
        e.multiplier * im.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_num ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
),
-- Get all inventory IDs that need to be considered (the root set + all nested sets + all minifigs)
all_inventories AS (
    SELECT 
        e.root_inventory_id,
        e.item_type,
        e.item_id,
        e.multiplier,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.item_type = 'set' THEN (
                SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_id ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
            )
            WHEN e.item_type = 'minifig' THEN (
                SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = e.item_id ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
            )
        END AS inv_id
    FROM exploded e
)
SELECT * FROM all_inventories LIMIT 10
"}

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current inventory for each set and minifig
set_current_inv AS (
    SELECT s.set_num, MAX(i.id) AS inventory_id
    FROM sets s
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = s.set_num
    GROUP BY s.set_num
),
minifig_current_inv AS (
    SELECT m.fig_num, MAX(i.id) AS inventory_id
    FROM minifigs m
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = m.fig_num
    GROUP BY m.fig_num
),
-- Recursive expansion of set contents
expanded_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from set inventories (non-spare)
    SELECT sci.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS total_qty
    FROM set_current_inv sci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: direct parts from minifig inventories (non-spare)
    SELECT sci.set_num, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, im.quantity * ip.quantity AS total_qty
    FROM set_current_inv sci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    JOIN minifig_current_inv mci ON mci.fig_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = mci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets
    SELECT sci.set_num, ec.part_num, ec.color_id, iset.quantity * ec.total_qty AS total_qty
    FROM set_current_inv sci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    JOIN expanded_contents ec ON ec.set_num = iset.set_num
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT set_num) AS num_sets
FROM expanded_contents
WHERE part_num = '15503'
"}

-- First, get the color_id for Trans-Brown
color_info AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Trans-Brown'
),

-- Get current inventory for each set and minifig
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT id, set_num, version,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn
    FROM inventories
),

-- Recursive expansion: starting from sets, expand through nested sets and minifigs
-- We track the root set and the current inventory we're exploring
recursive_contents AS (
    -- Base: all sets as roots, pointing to their own inventory contents
    SELECT 
        i.set_num AS root_set,
        i.id AS current_inventory_id,
        1 AS quantity_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM current_inventories i
    WHERE i.rn = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        rc.root_set,
        -- For nested sets: get their current inventory
        CASE 
            WHEN inv_s.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN ci.id
            WHEN inv_m.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN ci_m.id
            ELSE NULL
        END AS current_inventory_id,
        rc.quantity_multiplier * COALESCE(inv_s.quantity, inv_m.quantity, 1) AS quantity_multiplier,
        CASE 
            WHEN inv_s.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
            WHEN inv_m.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'
            ELSE 'unknown'
        END AS item_type
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    -- Nested sets
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets inv_s ON inv_s.inventory_id = rc.current_inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = inv_s.set_num AND ci.rn = 1
    -- Minifigs
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs inv_m ON inv_m.inventory_id = rc.current_inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN current_inventories ci_m ON ci_m.set_num = inv_m.fig_num AND ci_m.rn = 1
    WHERE inv_s.set_num IS NOT NULL OR inv_m.fig_num IS NOT NULL
),

-- Get all inventory_ids (including original set inventories) that are part of each root set
all_inventories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT root_set, current_inventory_id, quantity_multiplier
    FROM recursive_contents
    WHERE current_inventory_id IS NOT NULL
),

matching_parts AS (

    FROM all_inventories ai
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ai.current_inventory_id
    JOIN color_info c ON c.color_id = ip.color_id
    WHERE ip.part_num = '4864b'
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
)

SELECT root_set AS set_num
FROM matching_parts
ORDER BY root_set"}

    SELECT 
        id,
        set_num,
        MAX(version) OVER (PARTITION BY set_num) AS max_version
    FROM inventories
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode set contents at all levels

exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start with all sets' direct inventory items
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ci.set_num AS current_item,
        1 AS multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM current_inventories ci
    WHERE ci.version = ci.max_version
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in set inventories
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num AS current_item,
        ip.quantity * e.multiplier AS multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON e.current_item = ci.set_num AND ci.version = ci.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci.id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        iset.set_num AS current_item,
        iset.quantity * e.multiplier AS multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON e.current_item = ci.set_num AND ci.version = ci.max_version
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON ci.id = iset.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        im.fig_num AS current_item,
        im.quantity * e.multiplier AS multiplier,
        'minifig' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON e.current_item = ci.set_num AND ci.version = ci.max_version
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON ci.id = im.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts in minifig inventories
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num AS current_item,
        ip.quantity * e.multiplier AS multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON e.current_item = ci.set_num AND ci.version = ci.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci.id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'minifig'

),

-- Get all sets that contain part 3850 in Reddish Brown at any level

      )
)

set_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '391114-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all parts at all levels
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from the set's inventory (non-spare)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        0 AS level,
        'direct' AS source
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN set_inventory si ON ip.inventory_id = si.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets
    -- For each nested set, get its current inventory and explode it
    SELECT 
        ep.part_num,
        ep.color_id,
        isets.quantity * ep.total_quantity AS total_quantity,
        ep.level + 1 AS level,
        'nested_set' AS source
    FROM inventory_sets isets
    JOIN set_inventory si ON isets.inventory_id = si.inventory_id
    JOIN (
        -- Get current inventory for each nested set and explode it
        SELECT 
            i.set_num,
            i.id AS nested_inventory_id
        FROM inventories i
        WHERE (i.set_num, i.version) IN (
            SELECT set_num, MAX(version)
            FROM inventories
            GROUP BY set_num
        )
    ) current_inv ON isets.set_num = current_inv.set_num
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT * FROM exploded_parts_helper(current_inv.nested_inventory_id)
    ) ep ON TRUE
),

-- Helper function-like CTE for nested set explosion
exploded_parts_helper(inventory_id_param) AS (
    -- Direct parts
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        0 AS level,
        'direct' AS source

set_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '10785-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC

expanded AS (
    -- Base: the set's own inventory
    SELECT 
        si.inventory_id,
        1.0 AS multiplier,
        'root' AS item_type,
        '10785-1' AS item_id
    FROM set_inventory si
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets in the current inventory
    SELECT 
        child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
        e.multiplier * inv_s.quantity AS multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        inv_s.set_num AS item_id
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_sets inv_s ON inv_s.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = inv_s.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('root', 'set')  -- sets can contain nested sets
    AND child_inv.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = inv_s.set_num
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand minifigs in the current inventory
    SELECT 
        child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
        e.multiplier * inv_m.quantity AS multiplier,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        inv_m.fig_num AS item_id
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs inv_m ON inv_m.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = inv_m.fig_num
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('root', 'set')  -- minifigs can be in root or nested sets
    AND child_inv.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = inv_m.fig_num
    )
),
-- Calculate total parts from all levels (excluding spares)

    SELECT SUM(e.multiplier * ip.quantity) AS total_qty
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
